reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked used by all providers, but re-writes unlinkAccount's local field reset and the per-provider 'Account with ID ... not found' check instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: Adds a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's nulled-field update and a second copy of the upgrading-account existence check that each link function already performs.

placement.why: The unlinking write and an existence check are placed inside a function named and used as a precondition assertion, so the guard now mutates other accounts.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading and the takeover handling change.

maintainability.why: A mutating 'assert' and a second list of fields to clear will drift from unlinkAccount; the hand-threaded flag in six functions is tolerable given the existing structure.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source with its own db.updateAccount rather than a shared local-unlink step from unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: Both copies (the unlink field reset and the not-found check) are open copies of existing code, not reshaped.
